prompt: A casual snapshot from an old digital camera, looking up at the top of a street sign pole against a pale blue sky with soft white clouds. The black rectangular LED board on a dark metal gantry displays glowing amber dot-matrix capital letters in three centered lines:
"REMINDER:"
"HELLO MLX"
"IT RUNS LOCALLY NOW"
Calm evening atmosphere, slight sensor noise, everyday roadside photo.
